message: Ah, storm season is upon us again! I remember trying to explain to my grandkids why we should take a little extra time to prepare when the skies turn dark. They thought it was just a chance to play inside — and who can blame them? But I found a handy resource that lays out some good tips for staying safe during those wild weather moments. It’s a gentle reminder that a little preparation can go a long way, and maybe keep the kiddos from turning the living room into a makeshift fort. 🌪️
